answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 164419 Country: India Title: A person died in my relative circle. On the 2nd day Fatiha was held and I didn't attend it. Did I commit any sin? Question: A person died in my relative circle. On the 2nd day Fatiha was held and I didn't attend it. Did I commit any sin? Answer ID: 164419 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1262/1014/SN=01/1440) You did not sin rather you did a good job. The prevalent Fatiha is not proved and it is bida’h. It is mandatory to avoid participating in it. People should individually do isal-e-sawab for the deceased person by sadaqah, charity, tilawat and tasbihat etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
